name: Shirin Jarabawar GED: Lissafi
objectives: Ta amfani da ged.com da jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta, jera fannonin jarabawar lissafi ta GED, lokacinta, dokokin na'urar lissafi da nau'o'in tambayoyi, da rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, tare da jadawalin mako-mako na makonni 6 zuwa 8 da ranar da kuke son rubuta jarabawa

Ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba, warware tambayoyi kan tsarin ayyukan lissafi, ɓangarorin lamba, lambobi masu korau, ma'auni (exponents) da tushen murabba'i (square roots), kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai

Idan aka ba ku tambayoyin labari da ƙananan bayanai, warware tambayoyin rabo, daidaiton rabo da kaso, da samun matsakaici (mean), tsakiya (median), mafi yawa (mode) da tazara (range), kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai

Idan aka ba ku tambayar labari ko daidaito, rubutawa da warware daidaito da rashin daidaito na layi mai harafi ɗaya, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai kuma kuna duba kowace amsa ta hanyar mayar da ita cikin tambayar

Ta amfani da takardar dabarbaru da na'urar lissafi, lissafa kewaye, fili, girman ciki (volume) da gefen da ya ɓace na alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, da ma'aunan da suka dace
Idan aka ba ku zane, tebur, maki biyu ko function, samun gangara, karanta ƙima da lissafa function, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Jarabawar, lambobi da bayanai

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Jarabawar lissafi ta GED da tsarin karatunku
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera yadda jarabawar lissafi ta GED take aiki, da fara tsarin karatu mai ranaku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da ged.com da jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta, za ku iya jera fannonin jarabawar lissafi ta GED, lokacinta, dokokin na'urar lissafi da nau'o'in tambayoyi, da rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, tare da jadawalin mako-mako na makonni 6 zuwa 8 da ranar da kuke son rubuta jarabawa.
Jarabawar GED tana da darussa huɗu: Lissafi, Harshe (Reasoning Through Language Arts), Kimiyya da Ilimin Zamantakewa (Social Studies). Kuna iya rubuta su ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ana kiran jarabawar lissafi Mathematical Reasoning. Tana da fannoni huɗu: Lissafi na Asali, Siffofi (Geometry), Aljabara na Asali, da Zane-zanen Jadawali da Function.
A cewar ged.com, jarabawar lissafi minti 115 ce, har da lokacin umarni da sake dubawa. Tana da sassa, da ɗan hutu tsakaninsu. Ana ba da na'urar lissafi a kan allo a sashe na 2; a cibiyar jarabawa kuna iya kawo na'urar lissafinku ta TI-30XS. Wasu tambayoyi dole a yi su ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba, don haka kuna buƙatar lissafin kai da na takarda ma. Ana ba ku takardar dabarbaru da takardar bayanin na'urar lissafi, don haka ba sai kun haddace dabarbaru ba.
Nau'o'in tambayoyi sun haɗa da zaɓi daga amsoshi (multiple choice), ja da ajiye (drag and drop), cike gurbi (fill-in-the-blank), zaɓar wuri (danna kan zane ko hoto) da jerin zaɓi (drop down). Ku duba ged.com kafin jarabawa, domin bayanai suna iya canjawa. A wasu jihohi ana amfani da jarabawar HiSET maimakon GED, ko tare da ita; jihar ce ke yanke shawara.
Ku fara da jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta a ged.com. Tana nuna muku allon da nau'o'in tambayoyi. Ku yi amfani da ita don gano batutuwan da suka fi muku wuya. Idan kun kusa, jarabawar atisaye ta hukuma, GED Ready, tana faɗa muku ko wataƙila kun shirya (ku duba kuɗinta a ged.com). Sannan ku tsara karatu: gajerun zama, kwanaki da yawa a mako, batu ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku je ged.com ku karanta shafin jarabawar lissafi da dokokin jiharku.
- Ku yi jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta ku rubuta sakamakonku.
- Ku jera batutuwan da suka yi muku wuya.
- Ku zaɓi ranaku da lokutan karatu na makonni 6 zuwa 8 masu zuwa, da ranaku na gaske.
- Ku sa batu ɗaya a kowace ranar karatu, kuna farawa da wanda ya fi muku wuya.
- Ku zaɓi ranar yin GED Ready, da ranar da kuke son rubuta ainihin jarabawar.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- GED: jarabawar da ta yi daidai da kammala sakandare daga GED Testing Service; cin darussa huɗu duka yana ba da takardar shaida mai daidai da ta sakandare.
- HiSET: wata jarabawar da ta yi daidai da kammala sakandare da ake amfani da ita a wasu jihohi.
- Takardar dabarbaru (formula sheet): takardar dabarbarun lissafi da ake ba ku lokacin jarabawa.
- TI-30XS: nau'in na'urar lissafi ta kimiyya da ake amfani da ita a jarabawar lissafi ta GED.
- GED Ready: jarabawar atisaye ta hukuma ta GED da ke nuna ko wataƙila kun shirya.
- Tsarin karatu: jadawalin da aka rubuta na abin da za ku karanta da lokacin da za ku karanta shi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Darussan jarabawa (Lissafi)
- GED Testing Service: Jarabawowin misali kyauta da GED Ready
- HiSET: jarabawar daidai da sakandare
Gwada yanzu: Ku je ged.com ku yi jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta. Ku rubuta sakamakonku da batutuwan da suka yi muku wuya. Sannan a takarda ku yi kalanda na makonni 6 zuwa 8 masu zuwa: ku zagaye ranakun karatunku, ku rubuta lokaci ga kowace, ku sa batun da ya fi muku wuya a rana ta farko. Wannan shi ne farkon aikinku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana jarabawar lissafi ta GED (abin da ta ƙunsa, lokaci, na'urar lissafi, takardar dabarbaru, nau'o'in tambayoyi) da fara tsarin karatu mai ranaku.

check.q: Dole ne ku haddace dabarbaru don jarabawar lissafi ta GED?
options: A'a, ana ba da takardar dabarbaru
Waɗanda ke bayan na'urar lissafi kawai
Sai idan kuna rubutawa ta intanet
check.why: GED Testing Service tana ba da takardar dabarbaru lokacin jarabawa.

check.q: A ina ya kamata ku duba sabbin dokoki da kuɗin GED na jiharku?
options: Wani rubutu a kafofin sada zumunta
Abokin da ya rubuta jarabawa shekaru da suka wuce
ged.com ko ofishin ilimin manya na jiharku
check.why: Dokoki da kuɗi suna canjawa kuma sun bambanta a kowace jiha; shafin hukuma ne majiyar.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Lissafin lambobi ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Warware tambayoyin tsarin ayyuka, ɓangarorin lamba, lambobi masu korau, ma'auni da tushen murabba'i da hannu.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba, za ku iya warware tambayoyi kan tsarin ayyukan lissafi, ɓangarorin lamba, lambobi masu korau, ma'auni (exponents) da tushen murabba'i (square roots), kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Tsarin ayyukan lissafi: ku fara da Baka (parentheses), sannan Ma'auni (exponents), sannan Ninkawa da Raba daga hagu zuwa dama, sannan Tarawa da Ragewa daga hagu zuwa dama. Wasu suna tuna shi da PEMDAS. Misali: 3 + 4 x (6 - 2)^2 / 8. Baka: 6 - 2 = 4. Ma'auni: 4^2 = 16. Ninkawa da raba daga hagu zuwa dama: 4 x 16 = 64, 64 / 8 = 8. Tarawa: 3 + 8 = 11.
Ɓangarorin lamba (fractions): don ninkawa, ku ninka na sama da na sama, na ƙasa da na ƙasa: 2/3 x 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2. Don raba, ku juya ɓangare na biyu ku ninka: 3/4 / 1/2 = 3/4 x 2/1 = 6/4 = 1 1/2. Don kwatanta ɓangarori da decimal, ku mayar da su duka decimal: 2/3 kusan 0.667 ne, don haka daga mafi ƙanƙanta: 0.65, 2/3, 0.7.
Lambobi masu korau (negative): -5 + 8 = 3. Rage lamba mai korau daidai yake da tarawa: 6 - (-2) = 8. Mai korau sau mai korau yana ba da mai kyau (positive): -3 x -4 = 12; mai korau sau mai kyau yana ba da mai korau: -3 x 4 = -12. A layin lambobi, lambobi suna ƙaruwa zuwa dama.
Ma'auni da tushe: 2^5 yana nufin 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 32. Tushen murabba'i (square root) yana warware murabba'i: tushen murabba'i na 49 shi ne 7, domin 7 x 7 = 49. Tushen murabba'i na 50 ya ɗan fi 7, domin 50 yana tsakanin 49 da 64.
Mataki-mataki:
- Baka tukuna.
- Sannan ma'auni da tushe.
- Sannan ninkawa da raba, daga hagu zuwa dama.
- Sannan tarawa da ragewa, daga hagu zuwa dama.
- Ɓangarorin lamba: ku ninka kai tsaye; don raba, ku juya na biyu ku ninka.
- Alamomi: alamomi iri ɗaya suna ninkawa zuwa mai kyau, daban-daban zuwa mai korau.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tsarin ayyukan lissafi (order of operations): tsarin da aka yarda da shi na yin matakan lissafi: baka, ma'auni, ninkawa da raba, tarawa da ragewa.
- Ma'auni (exponent): ƙaramar lamba a sama da ke faɗin sau nawa za a ninka lamba da kanta: 2^3 = 2 x 2 x 2.
- Tushen murabba'i (square root): lambar da idan aka ninka ta da kanta take ba da lambar: tushen murabba'i na 25 shi ne 5.
- Lamba mai korau (negative number): lambar da ta gaza sifili, kamar -4.
- Layin lambobi (number line): layi mai lambobi a jere; lambobi suna ƙaruwa zuwa dama.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Jarabawar lissafi, takardar dabarbaru da misalin tambaya
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi atisaye ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) 10 - 2 x 3 + 4. (2) 5/6 x 3/5. (3) 2/3 / 4/9. (4) -7 - (-10). (5) 3^3 - tushen murabba'i na 16. Amsoshi: (1) 10 - 6 + 4 = 8 (ninkawa tukuna). (2) 15/30 = 1/2. (3) 2/3 x 9/4 = 18/12 = 1 1/2. (4) -7 + 10 = 3. (5) 27 - 4 = 23. Ga duk wanda kuka yi kuskure, ku nemo matakin da ya ɓaci ku rubuta dokar da kuke buƙata.
Yanzu za ku iya yin tsarin ayyukan lissafi, ɓangarorin lamba, lambobi masu korau, ma'auni da tushen murabba'i da hannu.

check.why: Mai korau sau mai korau yana ba da mai kyau: 30.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Rabo, daidaiton rabo, kaso da bayanai
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Warware tambayoyin rabo, daidaiton rabo da kaso, da samun matsakaici, tsakiya, mafi yawa da tazara.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku tambayoyin labari da ƙananan bayanai, za ku iya warware tambayoyin rabo, daidaiton rabo da kaso, da samun matsakaici (mean), tsakiya (median), mafi yawa (mode) da tazara (range), kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Rabo (ratio) yana kwatanta yawa biyu: kofi 3 na fulawa ga kowane kofi 2 na sukari shi ne 3:2. Daidaiton rabo (proportion) yana cewa rabo biyu daidai suke. Don warware shi, ku ninka a ketare (cross-multiply). Misali: kofi 3 na fulawa suna yin biskit 24. Nawa ake buƙata don biskit 40? 3/24 = x/40, don haka 24x = 120 kuma x = kofi 5.
Tambayoyin kaso guda uku: (1) Nawa ne 35% na 80? 0.35 x 80 = 28. (2) 18 kaso nawa ne na 72? 18 / 72 = 0.25 = 25%. (3) Canjin kaso: farashi ya tashi daga $40 zuwa $50. Canjin shi ne $10, kuma 10 / 40 = 0.25, don haka ya ƙaru da 25%. Koyaushe ku raba canjin da yawan FARKO.
Bayanai: ga lambobi 4, 7, 7, 9, 13, matsakaici (mean) shi ne jimilla a raba da yawansu: 40 / 5 = 8. Tsakiya (median) ita ce lambar tsakiya idan an jera su: 7. Mafi yawa (mode) ita ce lambar da ta fi fitowa: 7. Tazara (range) ita ce mafi girma a rage mafi ƙanƙanta: 13 - 4 = 9. Idan akwai lambobi biyu a tsakiya, tsakiyar ita ce rabin hanya tsakaninsu.
Yiwuwa (probability) ita ce damar da wani abu zai faru: yawan hanyoyin da zai iya faruwa / jimillar sakamako. Jaka tana da duwatsun wasa (marbles) 3 ja da 9 shuɗi: damar samun ja ita ce 3/12 = 1/4, ko 25%.
Mataki-mataki:
- Daidaiton rabo: ku rubuta ɓangarori biyu daidai masu ma'auni iri ɗaya a wuri ɗaya, sannan ku ninka a ketare ku raba.
- Kaso na lamba: ku mayar da kason decimal ku ninka.
- Kaso nawa: sashe / duka, sannan ku mayar da shi kaso.
- Canjin kaso: canji / na farko.
- Matsakaici: ku tara, sannan ku raba da yawansu. Tsakiya: ku jera, ku nemo tsakiya.
- Mafi yawa: wanda ya fi fitowa. Tazara: mafi girma a rage mafi ƙanƙanta.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Rabo (ratio): kwatanta yawa biyu, kamar 3:2.
- Daidaiton rabo (proportion): rabo biyu da suka yi daidai, kamar 3/24 = 5/40.
- Ninkawa a ketare (cross-multiply): ninka na saman kowane ɓangare da na ƙasan ɗayan don warware daidaiton rabo.
- Matsakaici (mean): average: ku tara lambobin ku raba da yawansu.
- Tsakiya (median): lambar tsakiya idan an jera lambobin.
- Mafi yawa (mode): lambar da ta fi fitowa.
- Tazara (range): lamba mafi girma a rage mafi ƙanƙanta.
- Yiwuwa (probability): damar da wani abu zai faru, daga 0 (ba zai taɓa ba) zuwa 1 (koyaushe).
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Darussan jarabawa (Lissafi)
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ma'aunin taswira shi ne inci 1 : mil 20. Mil nawa ne inci 3.5? (2) Nawa ne 15% na 260? (3) Waya ta $250 yanzu $200 ce. Mene ne kason ragi? (4) Ku nemo matsakaici, tsakiya, mafi yawa da tazara na 12, 15, 15, 18, 20, 22. Amsoshi: (1) mil 70. (2) 39. (3) 50 / 250 = ragin 20%. (4) Matsakaici 102 / 6 = 17; tsakiya rabin hanya tsakanin 15 da 18 = 16.5; mafi yawa 15; tazara 10.
Yanzu za ku iya warware daidaiton rabo da nau'o'i uku na tambayoyin kaso, da bayyana bayanai da matsakaici, tsakiya, mafi yawa da tazara.

check.why: A jere: 3, 4, 6, 8, 9. Lambar tsakiya ita ce 6.

check.q: Kaya na $60 ya tashi zuwa $75. Mene ne kason ƙaruwa?

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Aljabara, siffofi da zane-zanen jadawali

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Warware daidaito da rashin daidaito
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubutawa da warware daidaito da rashin daidaito masu harafi ɗaya, da duba kowace amsa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku tambayar labari ko daidaito, za ku iya rubutawa da warware daidaito da rashin daidaito na layi mai harafi ɗaya, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai kuma kuna duba kowace amsa ta hanyar mayar da ita cikin tambayar.
Harafin lissafi (variable) harafi ne, kamar x, da ke tsayawa a madadin lambar da ba a sani ba. Kalmomi suna zama lissafi: "5 fiye da ninki biyu na wata lamba" shi ne 2x + 5. "Wata lamba da aka rage da 7" shi ne x - 7. "Sakamakon ninka 4 da wata lamba" shi ne 4x.
Don warware daidaito (equation), ku yi abu ɗaya a ɓangarorin biyu har x ya kaɗaita. Ku fara warware tarawa ko ragewa, sannan ninkawa ko raba. Misali: 3x - 7 = 20. Ku ƙara 7: 3x = 27. Ku raba da 3: x = 9. Dubawa: 3 x 9 - 7 = 20. Eh. Misali mai baka: 2(x + 4) = 18. Ku raba da 2: x + 4 = 9, don haka x = 5.
Tambayar labari: tsarin waya yana cin $25 a wata da $0.10 ga kowane saƙon tes. Kuɗin ya kai $32. Saƙonni nawa? 25 + 0.10t = 32. Ku rage 25: 0.10t = 7. Ku raba da 0.10: t = saƙonni 70.
Rashin daidaito (inequalities) suna amfani da <, >, <= ko >= kuma ana warware su haka, da doka ɗaya: idan kun ninka ko raba ɓangarorin biyu da lamba mai korau, ku juya alamar. 4x + 3 > 19 yana ba da 4x > 16, don haka x > 4. Amma -2x <= 10 yana ba da x >= -5. A tambayoyin zaɓi daga amsoshi, kuna iya dubawa ta hanyar mayar da kowace amsa cikin tambayar.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku mayar da kalmomin daidaito da harafi a madadin abin da ba a sani ba.
- Ku warware tarawa ko ragewa a ɓangarorin biyu.
- Ku warware ninkawa ko raba a ɓangarorin biyu.
- Rashin daidaito: ku juya alamar idan kun ninka ko raba da lamba mai korau.
- Dubawa: ku mayar da amsarku cikin tambayar ta farko.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Harafin lissafi (variable): harafin da ke tsayawa a madadin lambar da ba a sani ba.
- Furuci (expression): lambobi, haruffa da ayyuka ba tare da alamar daidai ba, kamar 2x + 5.
- Daidaito (equation): jimlar lissafi mai alamar daidai, kamar 3x - 7 = 20.
- Rashin daidaito (inequality): jimlar lissafi da ke amfani da <, >, <= ko >= maimakon alamar daidai.
- Warwarewa (solve): samun ƙimar harafin da ke sa jimlar ta zama gaskiya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Darussan jarabawa (Lissafi)
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ku rubuta "8 ƙasa da ninki uku na wata lamba" a matsayin furuci. (2) Ku warware 5x + 6 = 41. (3) Ku warware 4(x - 2) = 28. (4) Tasi tana cin $3 da $2 a kowane mil. Tafiyar ta ci $19. Mil nawa? (5) Ku warware -3x + 1 > 13. Amsoshi: (1) 3x - 8. (2) 5x = 35, x = 7. (3) x - 2 = 7, x = 9. (4) 3 + 2m = 19, m = mil 8. (5) -3x > 12, don haka x < -4 (ku juya alamar). Ku duba kowace amsa ta hanyar mayar da ita ciki.
Yanzu za ku iya mayar da kalmomi daidaito, warware daidaito da rashin daidaito, da duba amsoshinku.

check.why: Ku rage 3: x / 4 = 5. Ku ninka da 4: x = 20.
Ku raba da -5 ku juya alamar: x > -4.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Siffofi da takardar dabarbaru da na'urar lissafi
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa kewaye, fili, girman ciki da gefen da ya ɓace na alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya ta amfani da takardar dabarbaru da na'urar lissafi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da takardar dabarbaru da na'urar lissafi, za ku iya lissafa kewaye, fili, girman ciki (volume) da gefen da ya ɓace na alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, da ma'aunan da suka dace.
Kewaye (perimeter) shi ne nisan zagayen siffa; ku tara gefunan. Fili (area) shi ne wurin da ke ciki, a ma'aunin murabba'i (square units). Girman ciki (volume) shi ne wurin da ke cikin abu mai girma uku (3-D), a ma'aunin cube (cubic units). Murabba'i mai tsawo ƙafa 8 da faɗi ƙafa 5 yana da kewaye 2 x (8 + 5) = ƙafa 26 da fili 8 x 5 = ƙafa murabba'i 40. Alwatika mai tushe 10 da tsawo 6 yana da fili 1/2 x 10 x 6 = 30.
Da'ira (circle) tana amfani da pi, kusan 3.14 (na'urar lissafi tana da maɓallin pi). Ga da'ira mai radius 3: fili = pi x r^2 = kusan 28.27 ma'aunin murabba'i; kewayen da'ira (circumference) = 2 x pi x r = kusan 18.85. Diameter ninki biyu ne na radius, don haka ku karanta a hankali wanne tambayar ta bayar.
Girman ciki: akwati mai 4 da 3 da 2 yana da girman ciki 4 x 3 x 2 = ma'aunin cube 24. Silinda (cylinder) mai radius 2 da tsawo 5 yana da girman ciki pi x r^2 x h = pi x 4 x 5 = kusan ma'aunin cube 62.83.
Alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya (right triangle): a^2 + b^2 = c^2 (dokar Pythagoras), inda c shi ne gefe mafi tsawo, a gaban kusurwa madaidaiciya. Idan ƙafafun alwatikan 6 da 8 ne, c^2 = 36 + 64 = 100, don haka c = 10. Ana ba ku takardar dabarbaru a jarabawa: ku yi atisaye da sabuwar takardar daga ged.com don ku san inda kowace dabara take. A TI-30XS, ku yi amfani da maɓallin (-) don lambobi masu korau da maɓallin x^2 don murabba'i; takardar bayanin na'urar lissafi ta GED tana nuna maɓallan.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zana siffar ku rubuta abin da kuka sani a jikinta.
- Ku yanke: kewaye (zagaye), fili (ciki, fale-fale) ko girman ciki (ciki, 3-D)?
- Ku nemo dabarar a takardar dabarbaru.
- Ku saka lambobin ku yi amfani da na'urar lissafi.
- Ku rubuta ma'aunan: ƙafa, ƙafa murabba'i ko ƙafa cube.
- Ku tambayi kanku: amsar ta dace da zanen?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Kewaye (perimeter): nisan zagayen siffa fale-fale.
- Fili (area): wurin da ke cikin siffa fale-fale, a ma'aunin murabba'i.
- Girman ciki (volume): wurin da ke cikin abu mai girma uku, a ma'aunin cube.
- Radius: nisa daga tsakiyar da'ira zuwa gefenta; diameter ninki biyu ne na radius.
- Pi: lambar kusan 3.14 da ake amfani da ita da da'ira.
- Dokar Pythagoras (Pythagorean theorem): ga alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya, a^2 + b^2 = c^2, inda c shi ne gefe mafi tsawo.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Jarabawar lissafi, takardar dabarbaru da misalin tambaya
- GED Testing Service: Takardar bayanin na'urar lissafi TI-30XS (PDF)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi atisaye da na'urar lissafi da takardar dabarbaru daga ged.com (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Fili da kewayen murabba'i mai tsawo m 12 da m 7. (2) Filin da'ira mai diameter inci 10. (3) Girman cikin akwati ƙafa 6 da ƙafa 2 da ƙafa 3. (4) Tsani mai ƙafa 13 ya jingina da bango, ƙafarsa ƙafa 5 daga bangon. Har ina zai kai a bangon? Amsoshi: (1) fili mita murabba'i 84, kewaye m 38. (2) radius 5, fili kusan inci murabba'i 78.54. (3) ƙafa cube 36. (4) 5^2 + b^2 = 13^2, don haka b^2 = 169 - 25 = 144, b = ƙafa 12.
Yanzu za ku iya samun kewaye, fili, girman ciki da gefen da ya ɓace na alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya, da ma'aunan da suka dace.

check.q: Ɗaki yana da ƙafa 14 da ƙafa 10. Mene ne filinsa?
check.why: Fili = tsawo x faɗi = 140, a ƙafa murabba'i.

check.q: Alwatika mai kusurwa madaidaiciya yana da ƙafafu 9 da 12. Tsawon gefe mafi tsawo nawa ne?
check.why: 81 + 144 = 225, kuma tushen murabba'i na 225 shi ne 15.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Gangara, zane-zanen jadawali da function
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Samun gangara, karanta zane-zane da tebura, lissafa function, da kammala tsarin karatu da jarabawarku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku zane, tebur, maki biyu ko function, za ku iya samun gangara, karanta ƙima da lissafa function, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai. Ta amfani da ged.com da jarabawar misali ta lissafi ta GED kyauta, za ku iya jera fannonin jarabawar lissafi ta GED, lokacinta, dokokin na'urar lissafi da nau'o'in tambayoyi, da rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, tare da jadawalin mako-mako na makonni 6 zuwa 8 da ranar da kuke son rubuta jarabawa.
Grid na coordinate yana da layin x (x-axis, a kwance) da layin y (y-axis, sama da ƙasa). Ana rubuta maki (x, y): (3, 5) yana nufin 3 a kwance, 5 sama. Gangara (slope) tana faɗin yadda layi yake da tsauri: hawa a raba da tafiya (rise over run), ko (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1). Daga (1, 3) zuwa (4, 9): (9 - 3) / (4 - 1) = 6 / 3 = 2. Layin da ke hawa daga hagu zuwa dama yana da gangara mai kyau (positive); mai sauka, gangara mai korau (negative).
Ana iya rubuta layi y = mx + b, inda m shi ne gangara kuma b shi ne inda layin ya ketare layin y. Daga tebur inda x = 0, 1, 2 yana ba da y = 5, 8, 11, y yana ƙaruwa da 3 kowane lokaci, don haka m = 3, kuma idan x = 0, y = 5, don haka b = 5: y = 3x + 5.
Function tana ba da sakamako ɗaya ga kowace shigarwa. f(x) = x^2 - 3x yana nufin: ku ɗauki shigarwar, ku ninka ta da kanta, ku rage ninki 3 nata. f(4) = 16 - 12 = 4. A zane, ku nemo ƙimar ta hanyar tafiya a kwance zuwa x da kuke so, sannan sama ko ƙasa zuwa layin, sannan a kwance don karanta y.
Ku kammala tsarinku. Ku duba makinku a ƙananan gwaje-gwaje, gwaje-gwajen ilimi da jarabawar misali. Ku sa batutuwa 3 da suka fi muku wuya a farko a jadawalinku na mako-mako, ku ƙara ranakun sake dubawa, ku zaɓi ranakun GED Ready da ainihin jarabawa, bayan kun duba dokokin jiharku a ged.com.
Mataki-mataki:
- Gangara: ku rage ƙimomin y, ku rage ƙimomin x a tsari iri ɗaya, ku raba.
- y = mx + b: m shi ne gangara, b shi ne ƙimar y idan x = 0.
- Daga tebur: yawan canjin y duk lokacin da x ya ƙaru da 1 shi ne gangara.
- Function: ku sa lambar a madadin x ku bi tsarin ayyukan lissafi.
- Tsari: batutuwa mafi wuya tukuna, ranaku na gaske, GED Ready kafin ainihin jarabawa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Grid na coordinate (coordinate grid): grid mai layin x da layin y don sanya maki.
- Maki biyu a jere (ordered pair): maki da aka rubuta (x, y).
- Gangara (slope): yadda layi yake da tsauri: hawa a raba da tafiya.
- y-intercept: inda layi ya ketare layin y; b a cikin y = mx + b.
- Function: doka da ke ba da sakamako ɗaya tak ga kowace shigarwa, kamar f(x) = 2x + 1.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: Darussan jarabawa (Lissafi)
- GED Testing Service: Jarabawowin misali kyauta da GED Ready
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ku nemo gangara daga (2, 1) zuwa (6, 9). (2) Ku rubuta daidaiton layi mai gangara -2 da ya ketare layin y a 7. (3) Idan f(x) = 3x - 4, ku nemo f(5). (4) Tebur yana da x = 0, 1, 2 da y = 10, 7, 4. Mece ce gangarar? Amsoshi: (1) 8 / 4 = 2. (2) y = -2x + 7. (3) 15 - 4 = 11. (4) y yana raguwa da 3 kowane lokaci, don haka -3. Sannan ku kammala aikinku na ƙarshe: jadawalinku na mako-mako mai ranaku, tambayoyin atisaye 12 da bayanin waɗanda kuka yi kuskure, da ranakun GED Ready da jarabawarku.
Yanzu za ku iya samun gangara, rubuta y = mx + b, karanta zane-zane da tebura, lissafa function, da bin tsarin karatu da jarabawar lissafi ta GED mai ranaku.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Ya san jarabawar Bai yi jarabawar misali kyauta ba, ko tsarin ba shi da bayanan jarabawa daga ged.com. An rubuta sakamakon jarabawar misali; an jera fannoni, lokaci, dokokin na'urar lissafi da nau'o'in tambayoyi daga ged.com. Ya kuma jera dokokin jihar (GED ko HiSET), yadda ake tsara rana da kuɗin yanzu, daga shafin hukuma. Tsarin karatu mai ranaku Babu ranaku, ko babu tsarin batutuwa. Ranakun karatu na makonni 6 zuwa 8 da ranaku da lokuta na gaske, batutuwa 3 mafi wuya tukuna, ranar GED Ready da ranar jarabawa. Yana da ranakun sake dubawa da tsarin madadi don zaman da aka rasa. Lissafin lambobi da bayanai Ƙasa da 3 cikin 4 na tambayoyin atisayen lambobi da bayanai daidai. Aƙalla 3 cikin 4 na tambayoyin lambobi da bayanai (Darasi na 2 da na 3) daidai, da bayanin duk kuskure. Duka daidai, da aikin da aka nuna a sarari mataki-mataki. Aljabara An warware daidaiton atisaye ba tare da dubawa ba, ko ɗaya ko duka biyu ba daidai ba. Tambayoyin aljabara biyu duka daidai kuma an duba su ta hanyar mayar da amsar ciki. Ya bayyana dokar juya alama a rashin daidaito da kalmominsa. Siffofi da zane-zanen jadawali An yi amfani da dabarar da ba daidai ba, babu ma'auni, ko alamar gangara ba daidai ba. Tambayoyin siffofi da zane-zane (Darasi na 5 da na 6) galibi daidai, da ma'auni da alamomin gangara daidai. Yana iya nuna inda kowace dabara take a takardar dabarbaru da zana jadawali don tambayar gangara. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe, sannan ku nuna tsarin ga malami ko abokin karatu.
